summary: Open TaskFingerprint with deterministic structural hash and a pluggable, optional embedding backend that degrades to structure
implementation: src/shared/task-fingerprint.ts (+): FingerprintInput; deterministic derivations — deriveSpecificity (vague vs detailed goal), deriveContextScale (log-bounded), deriveModalities (keyword→modality set, text default, never empty), deriveExternalEffectLevel (TaskIR execution risk + explicit high-effect wording); buildStructuralFingerprint (sorted capability/modality sets so ordering cannot change the hash, FNV-1a structuralHash) — NO topic enum anywhere

electron/learning/task-fingerprint.ts: TaskFingerprinter — optional EmbeddingBackend (pluggable) + SemanticVectorStore (in-memory default); build() adds a semanticVectorRef only for a usable in-time vector, otherwise returns the structural fingerprint with an explanatory note; structural-only buildStructural() path; never throws (missing/slow/throwing/malformed backend ⇒ structural fallback)
tests: tests/unit/engine-phase-4.test.ts (11 tests): deterministic, enum-free fingerprint; capability/modality order independence; derivation ranges (specificity/contextScale/externalEffect) + high-effect wording boost; concepts ride along without changing the structural hash; hash stability/sensitivity; semantic path stores a vector by reference; fallback with no backend / throwing backend / malformed vector / timeout / empty goal — all keep a usable structural fingerprint
notes: Phase 4 requirement 'embedding backend may be unavailable but must degrade to a deterministic structural fingerprint' is proven by four independent failure-injection tests.
